points.text: Every dividend it declared in 2023, 2024 and 2025 was ordinary income on a tax basis. None was return of capital.
Return of capital is what lowers cost basis and defers tax to the sale. With none, BCRED's payouts are taxed in the year they're received.

points.text: BXPE is treated as a partnership for U.S. tax purposes, so its taxable income is allocated to its unitholders.
BXPE expects to generate taxable income in excess of cash distributions to unitholders, partly from annual income inclusions from foreign companies it elects to treat as qualified electing funds.
